meta.what: Share of 1,000 scattered landers whose touchdown point still passes the assumed power, comm and approach criteria for the 14-day mission, for each candidate site and a landing at every hour. Not the probability of a safe touchdown.
meta.method: pipeline/run_landing_success_hourly.py: the calculation of run_landing_success.py with the mission window starting at every hour. Approach lighting and the approach heading are the daily values of the landing's UTC date.
meta.limits: The landing error (sigma) and all criteria are assumed values. Slopes, hazards and guidance are not modelled.
meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (SI) during the event; data are NASA LOLA + JPL Horizons.
